rule: Text contrast at least 4.5:1 against its background (large text 3:1)
why: Readable in sunlight and for low vision

rule: Non-text UI parts and state indicators at least 3:1 against adjacent colours
anti_pattern: Light grey input borders on white

rule: Pointer targets at least 24x24 CSS px, with 44 recommended for touch
Focused element never fully hidden by sticky headers, footers or sheets
anti_pattern: Focus lands under a sticky action bar

rule: Do not ask for information already entered in the same flow; autofill or prefill it
anti_pattern: Re-typing the phone number at checkout

rule: No cognitive test for sign-in; PIN pads and passkeys allowed, no puzzles or transcription
Drag operations have a single-pointer alternative (select then move)
Visible focus ring with 3:1 contrast and at least 2px thickness
Every image and icon-only control has a text alternative
Form fields have programmatic labels; placeholder is never the only label
Errors identified in text next to the field and announced
Status messages announced via live regions without moving focus
Colour is never the only carrier of meaning; pair with icon, text or pattern
anti_pattern: Queue age shown by colour alone

rule: Content reflows at 320 CSS px width without horizontal scroll (tables may scroll)
Text can scale to 200% without loss of content
Headings and landmarks structure every page (one h1, main, nav)
anti_pattern: Divs with bold text as headings

rule: Keyboard operable everything; no keyboard traps
Skip link to main content on web pages
anti_pattern: No skip link on admin pages

rule: Time limits can be extended or turned off; session warnings before expiry
Motion, blinking and parallax respect prefers-reduced-motion
Language of the page and of language switches is declared
Consistent navigation and identification across screens
anti_pattern: Same action named differently per screen

rule: Touch targets spaced so 24px circles do not overlap
Autocomplete attributes on personal fields (name, tel, email)
Pointer cancellation: actions on up event, not down
Help mechanism (support link) in the same place on every page
Controls at least 44x44 pt
Controls at least 48x48 dp with 8 dp spacing
Primary action reachable by thumb on phones (bottom zone)
anti_pattern: Save button top-right only on phone

rule: Swipe gestures have a visible button alternative
Long-press reveals secondary actions with haptic or visual cue
Touch feedback within 100 ms (pressed state)
Scrollable regions show scroll affordance (partial item, shadow)
Pull to refresh only on feeds; never on transactional screens
Keyboard shows the right type (numeric for amounts) or use the app numpad
Destructive actions need a second step or undo, never a double tap
Drag handles at least 44 px and visible
Gestures never conflict with system edges (back swipe, home indicator)
Hover-only affordances have a touch equivalent
Stylus and mouse supported alongside touch on Windows terminals
Largest Contentful Paint under 2.5 s on 4G
Interaction to Next Paint under 200 ms
Cumulative Layout Shift under 0.1; reserve space for images and ads
Skeletons for loads over 300 ms; spinners only for indeterminate short waits
Lists over 100 rows virtualised
Debounce search input 200 to 300 ms
Optimistic updates for toggles and state changes with rollback
anti_pattern: Waiting for server on every tap

rule: Images served responsive with width/height set and lazy loading below the fold
Code split by route; POS shell under 200 KB gzipped
Offline-first screens read from local store first, then reconcile
Fonts preloaded with font-display swap; at most 2 families
Animations use transform and opacity only
One accent colour; every other colour is neutral or semantic
Radius scale of at most 3 values used consistently per component class
Shadows from a 3-step scale; flat by default on operational screens
Icons from one set (Lucide) at 20 or 24 px; never emoji as icons
Spacing from a 4 px scale
Buttons: one primary per view; secondary outlined; tertiary text
Semantic colours used only for meaning (success, warning, danger, info)
Component states defined for default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error
Same term for the same thing in UI copy (CONTEXT.md glossary)
Dark theme is a token swap, not a redesign
Empty states share one pattern: illustration or icon, one line, one action
Density set once per product (comfortable, high) and honoured by tables and lists
Breakpoints: phone under 640, tablet 640 to 1024, desktop above; layouts defined for each
Content max width 1280 px for reading screens; operational screens use full width
Sidebar collapses to drawer under 1024 px
Primary action in a sticky footer on long forms
anti_pattern: Save at the bottom of a scroll

rule: Tables: sticky header, horizontal scroll with pinned first column on phones
Split layouts (list plus detail) become stacked with back navigation on phones
Safe areas respected (notch, home indicator, rounded corners)
Grid gutters 16 px on phone, 24 px on tablet and desktop
Modal dialogs max 560 px wide; larger flows use a page or full-screen sheet
Line length 45 to 75 characters for body text
Operational screens: action bar fixed, content scrolls; never scroll the numpad
Landscape and portrait both supported on tablets
Base text 16 px; operational screens 16 to 18 px; never below 12 px
Type scale ratio between 1.125 and 1.333 with at most 7 steps
Line height 1.4 to 1.6 for body, 1.1 to 1.25 for headings
Tabular numerals for money, quantities and timers
Money shows currency and minor units per region; right-aligned in tables
Two weights carry hierarchy (regular, semibold); bold reserved for totals
Muted text still 4.5:1
Links distinguishable without colour alone in body text (underline)
Truncate with ellipsis and full text on focus or tooltip; never clip silently
Uppercase only for short labels, with letter spacing
Avoid pure black on pure white for long text; use near-black on off-white
Durations 100 to 400 ms; enter shorter than exit
Easing: standard for movement, decelerate for enter, accelerate for exit
Reduced-motion variant removes movement, keeps state change
Motion communicates state (where it came from, where it went)
No looping or auto-playing motion on operational screens
Skeleton shimmer at most 1.5 s period, disabled under reduced motion
Validate on blur, re-validate on change after first error, summarise on submit
Error copy says what happened and how to fix it in one sentence
Submit stays enabled; errors listed on attempt
Success confirmation within 500 ms; toasts 4 s; errors persistent with an action
Unsaved changes guard on navigation
Typed confirmation for irreversible deletes
Inline helper text below fields; never tooltips as the only help
Required fields marked and stated once at the top (all required unless marked optional)
Numeric inputs use numpad or stepper with min, max and step
Progress for jobs over 2 s: determinate when count known
Autosave drafts on long forms with visible saved-at status
Server errors map back to the field that caused them
Current location visible (active nav item, breadcrumb on detail)
Back is predictable: returns to the previous list with state preserved
At most 7 top-level destinations; the rest under More or settings
Global search or command palette reachable with one shortcut
Tabs for sibling views; never for sequential steps
URL holds list state (filters, page, sort) on web
Role-based navigation: items the role cannot use are hidden, not disabled
Bottom tab bar on phones for 3 to 5 destinations
Modal flows have a visible close and Escape
Deep links resolve to the screen with correct state (order id, branch)
One chart per report view with a data table alternative
Categorical colours colour-blind safe (blue, orange, teal, purple); never red/green alone
Axes labelled with units; zero baseline for bars
Time series default to the last 7 days with hour granularity for POS
KPI tiles: value, delta with direction icon, period; tabular numerals
Sortable tables announce sort state; sorted column marked
Tooltips on charts keyboard reachable; values also in a table
Currency formatting per branch locale in every chart
Empty and error states for charts with retry
Mobile fallback: sparkline or table for complex charts
Numpad first: 3x4 grid, 64 dp keys, 00 and backspace, value shown large above
Quantity chips 1 to 9 beside items; tap again increments
Offline banner persistent, non-blocking, with queue count
Manager PIN modal shows action summary and reason chips before the PIN
Tabular numerals and right alignment for every amount
High-density tables at 36 px rows on operational screens with sticky totals
Amount due at 48 px, top of the tender screen, live region
Quick cash buttons: exact, next notes; change shown in 40 px
Item grid tiles at least 96 x 72 dp with name and price
Modifier sheet opens automatically for required groups; Done shows running total
Card wait state: spinner, cancel after 5 s, timeout 60 s with retry or other tender
Receipt preview at 80 mm with language toggle and print, e-receipt, no receipt
Split-bill remaining bar turns green at zero; Pay per column
Shift close blocked list links to each open order
Sync status icon in header with synced, queued n, conflict states
Undo for 10 s after merge, transfer and void
Sold-out items greyed with 86 tag and still visible
Customer display mirrors lines and total; tip prompt only during tender
Printer status chip: ready, paper low, offline; print queues when offline
Search field accepts PLU digits and text; scanner input lands here
Dashboard KPIs limited to four with one activity feed
Reports default to today and this branch
Layout, navigation, tabs, lists and swipe directions mirror in RTL
Numerals, prices, phone numbers, QR codes and numpads stay LTR in RTL
Use logical CSS properties (margin-inline-start) everywhere
Arabic fonts with Naskh or Kufi fallback at 18 px minimum; Urdu Nastaliq at 20 px
Bidi isolation for mixed runs (unicode-bidi: isolate) in names and addresses
Icons with direction (arrows, back) mirror; icons without (clock, search) do not
Dates and numbers formatted per locale with Western numerals by default, Arabic-Indic as a branch option
Language switch persists per user and per receipt
Text expansion allowance of 30% for Arabic and Urdu in buttons and tables
Pseudo-localisation test in CI for length and RTL
Right-aligned amounts in both directions
Bilingual receipts carry identical totals in both blocks
80 mm receipt: 72 mm printable width, 42 columns at font A, 56 at font B
Thermal contrast: no greys, no thin lines under 2 px, bold for totals
QR code at least 25 mm square with quiet zone; one per receipt
Header: branch name, address, tax number; footer: receipt number, date, device
Bilingual receipt: Arabic block first for SA, English first for AE unless toggled
Reprint stamped REPRINT; voided receipts print VOID
Cut and drawer commands only after successful render
Print jobs queue when the printer is offline with a visible count
A4 reports: page numbers, generated-at, branch filter in header
Reading order matches visual order; no CSS order tricks that break tab order
Custom controls expose name, role and value (aria) and reflect state changes
Error prevention on financial actions: review step or undo for payments and refunds
Instructions never rely on shape, size or location alone
anti_pattern: Tap the round button on the right

rule: Audio cues paired with visual cues and can be muted
Content on hover or focus is dismissible, hoverable and persistent
Text spacing adjustable (line height 1.5, paragraph 2x) without clipping
Page titles describe the screen and current record
Link and button text describes the destination or action
No content flashes more than three times per second
Orientation not locked unless essential
Motion actuation (shake, tilt) has a UI alternative and can be disabled
Primary tap targets on kiosks at least 64 dp
Confirm sheets slide from the bottom and are dismissible by drag and by button
Selection mode entered by long-press or a Select button, with a clear exit
Numeric entry commits on Enter and on tapping outside; no accidental submit on scroll
Rapid repeated taps are debounced on money actions
Gloved and wet-hand operation: no pressure or multi-touch gestures required
Order entry add-line renders within 100 ms locally
Background sync never blocks the UI thread; workers for queue drain
Cache menu and floor data locally; refresh on version change
Report queries paginate or aggregate server-side; never render raw rows over 1000
Print rendering under 300 ms; queue prints without blocking tender completion
Copy tone: short, present tense, no exclamation marks on operational screens
Numbers formatted once (helper) and used everywhere
Status badges use the same five colours and words across screens
Illustrations only in empty states and onboarding; none on operational screens
Logo appears once (sign-in and receipts), never on every screen
Two-column tender: totals left, keypad right; stacked on phone with keypad bottom
Item grid 4 columns on tablet landscape, 3 portrait, 2 phone
Sticky totals row in tables with money
Settings pages single column, max 720 px
Floor map fits the zone without scrolling on tablet; zoom on phone
Negative amounts show a minus sign, never colour alone; refunds in parentheses on receipts
Currency symbol or code once per column header in tables
Manager PIN prompt states the action and amount before asking
Void and comp require a reason chip; free text optional
Quantity edits show the resulting line total instantly
Search shows result count and highlights the match
Long-running exports notify on completion with a link
Operator screens reachable in one tap from the primary entry screen (tender, board, search)
Manager and owner areas behind a PIN with a visible locked icon
Branch switcher only for owner roles and only when more than one branch
Escape and Back always cancel the current sheet without side effects
Hourly sales chart marks service periods (breakfast, lunch, dinner)
Payment mix as stacked bar with labels, never a pie
Voids and discounts charted against sales as a percentage
P&L deltas use blue/orange in colour-blind mode
Order entry keeps the ticket visible while browsing categories
Seat and course tags visible on every ticket line
Delivery inbox plays a distinct sound and shows platform logo and ETA
End-of-day checklist blocks with links to each unresolved item
Receipt reprint and void receipts clearly stamped
Reservation timeline scrolls horizontally with now-line and 15-minute grid
Inventory low-stock badge on the item tile and the inventory list
Staff PIN entry never echoes digits; shows count only
Floor canvas and seat numbers never mirror; labels do
Receipt currency symbol position per locale (AED before, د.إ after)
Item names entered in both languages; fallback shows the other language, never blank
Urdu digits and Arabic-Indic digits are a branch setting, default Western
Receipt totals block: subtotal, discounts, service charge, tax lines, total, tenders, change
Barcode or QR on receipts encodes receipt number for refund lookup
Paper-low warning at 20% with reorder link
